privacyDraft: Draft privacy notice — pending legal review
privacyBody: SnapMatch is being developed to help guests find their photos within a single event. Before camera access, guests will be asked for consent. Selfies will be processed in memory for matching and will not be saved. Event face data will expire on the date shown for that event. Photos will be private, and guests will receive access only to their matched photos. A removal option will be provided. Contact details, retention rules, legal basis and processor information must be completed before launch.

landing.faqTitle: A few things you might wonder.

faqs.q: Is SnapMatch available to use today?
faqs.a: Photographer sign-in, profiles, event setup, QR posters and bulk uploads are built. Face search and guest photo delivery are still in development. The gallery shown here is an illustrative preview.
The planned guest flow starts with an event QR code and consent. Guests will not need to create an account.

faqs.q: What happens to a guest’s selfie?
faqs.a: The planned search processes the selfie in memory and discards it. Event face data has its own expiry date. The full privacy notice is awaiting legal review.
The interface supports Azerbaijani, Russian and English, with Azerbaijani as the default.
